card.name: "Contribute to" in C. difficile warning
card.fires_on: The word "to" right after "contribute" in the standard C. difficile-associated diarrhea warning ("toxins A and B which contribute to the development of CDAD").

modes.label: C. difficile toxins sentence
modes.description: The word "to" after "contribute" in the sentence about toxins A and B and CDAD.
modes.example: C. difficile produces toxins A and B which contribute<< to>> the development of CDAD.
